A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Twi'lek Jedi''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. At some point, he arrested a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Valius Ying]] with the assistance of Republic [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Saul Karath]]. As a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a [[Green (disambiguation)|green]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]]. He also had green skin.<ref name="KotOR: War 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek Jedi first appeared in the [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: War]]'' miniseries. He was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] and penciled by [[Andrea Mutti]].
